'''Fuzzy''' was a nickname given by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who served as [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]]'s [[Secretary/Legends|secretary]] in [[44 ABY]].

During a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] organized [[Plan Delta|coup]] against Daala, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her husband [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were positioned in Daala's outer office, along with several ambassadors and Daala's secretary. When Han received the signal that the plan was underway, he and Leia took the [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] from the guards stationed in the outer office and held the room until the other Jedi came in. Han tried to have the Bothan open Daala's office for them but he refused, choosing not to believe Han's threats against his well being.
